intro.heading: Advanced, Comfortable Implant Care Led by Dr. Lavi
paragraphs: Missing teeth can affect how you eat, speak, and feel every day. At Valencia Dentistry, Dr. Nuriel Lavi provides dental implant treatment in Santa Clarita for patients missing one tooth, several teeth, or a full arch. Each case is carefully planned around your oral health, bone support, bite, smile goals, and comfort needs.
From your first consultation to your final restoration, our team focuses on clear communication, modern technology, and a supportive experience so you can feel confident about your treatment.

understanding.heading: What Are Dental Implants?
understanding.intro: Dental implants are long-lasting tooth replacements designed to restore missing teeth from the root up. An implant is a small titanium post placed in the jawbone, where it supports a custom crown, bridge, or denture. Because implants are anchored in the jawbone, they can provide strong chewing support, a natural look, and better stability than many removable tooth replacement options. At Valencia Dentistry, Dr. Lavi will evaluate your bone support, gum health, and smile goals to recommend the right implant option for you.

items.title: Zygomatic Implants
items.text: A specialized option anchored in the cheekbone (zygoma), typically used for severe bone loss in the upper jaw.

items.title: Implant-Supported Dentures
items.text: A more secure alternative to traditional removable dentures for patients missing many teeth.

items.title: Single Tooth Implants

process.heading: Our Dental Implant Process
process.intro: We make the dental implant process clear and comfortable from the first consultation to the final restoration. Your timeline may vary depending on your oral health, bone support, healing needs, and whether extractions or bone grafting are required.

steps.title: Consultation & Personalized Planning
steps.text: We begin with an exam, digital imaging, and a review of your health, bite, missing teeth, and smile goals. If needed, Dr. Lavi may recommend preparatory care such as extractions, periodontal treatment, or bone grafting.

steps.title: Implant Placement
steps.text: The implant is placed in the jawbone using a carefully planned approach. Local anesthesia is used, and sedation options may be available. Over time, the implant heals and bonds with the bone to create a stable foundation.

steps.title: Restoration & Smile Reveal
steps.text: After healing, a custom crown, bridge, or denture is attached to restore your smile. We check your bite, comfort, and healing so your implant restoration feels natural and functions properly.

candidate.heading: Who Is a Good Candidate for Dental Implants?
candidate.text: Many adults with missing teeth are candidates for dental implants, but every case needs a careful evaluation. During your consultation at Valencia Dentistry, Dr. Lavi will review your oral health, jawbone support, gum condition, bite, and medical history to determine the safest and most effective treatment plan. Even if you have bone loss, gum disease history, loose dentures, or failing teeth, you may still have implant options after the right preparation.
bullets: You are missing one or more teeth
You want a fixed replacement instead of a removable denture
Your gums are healthy or can be treated before implant placement
You have enough jawbone support, or you are open to bone grafting if needed
You want to improve chewing, speaking, and smile confidence

care.heading: Pre- And Post-Care For Dental Implants
care.intro: Proper preparation and aftercare can support smoother healing and better long-term results. Before and after your implant procedure, our team gives you personalized instructions based on your treatment plan, medical history, and comfort needs. For more guidance on eating during recovery, read our guide on the best foods after dental implant surgery.
before: Follow pre-op instructions from Dr. Lavi (this may include pausing certain medications or arranging a ride home if sedation is used)
Maintain good oral hygiene to reduce bacteria and inflammation
Eat a healthy, well-balanced diet leading up to surgery
after: Stick to soft foods for the first few days
Avoid smoking, drinking through straws, or intense physical activity
Keep the area clean with gentle rinses and brushing as advised
Take prescribed medication and attend follow-up visits for healing checks

faqs.q: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.a: With proper care and regular checkups, dental implants can last 20 years or more—often a lifetime. They’re one of the most durable tooth replacement options available.

faqs.q: Does getting a dental implant hurt?
faqs.a: The procedure is typically done under local anesthesia, with sedation options available for added comfort. Most patients report minimal discomfort during recovery, often less than a tooth extraction.

faqs.q: What is the cost of dental implants in Santa Clarita?
faqs.a: Costs vary depending on your specific treatment plan. At Valencia Dentistry, we offer transparent pricing, flexible financing, and a detailed breakdown before treatment begins.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get dental implants?
faqs.a: The full process can take a few months, depending on healing and any preparatory treatments like bone grafting. However, same-day implants may be possible in select cases.

faqs.q: Are dental implants safe for seniors?
faqs.a: Yes. Dental implants are a safe, effective option for older adults in good overall health and with sufficient bone density—or those open to bone grafting.

faqs.q: What’s the difference between dental implants and dentures?
faqs.a: Dental implants are permanent fixtures that integrate with your jawbone, providing a stable, natural-feeling replacement for missing teeth. Unlike traditional dentures, they don’t slip, don’t require adhesives, and help prevent bone loss over time.
